description: Pages on a SUSTAINED camera fault only, three tiers: DOWN (a camera offline) 8 min; SLOW/FROZEN (degraded, still serving frames) 30 min - transient stream blips self-recover well inside that window and paging on them is pure noise; FLEET-STALE (multiple cameras byte-identical to their previous probe - healthy cameras re-frame on every probe, so several simultaneously stale = a fleet-level snapshot-pipeline wedge) 5 min - the fastest tier because its false-positive rate is near zero.

data.title: ⚠️ Camera issue
